summary: Preserved the candidate's six Python/Rust unified-memory scenarios and corrected their oracle to require direct elementwise logprob equality. This rejects the independently reproduced 5.0000069648240756e-11 nonzero KL and differences small enough for KL arithmetic to round to zero. End-to-end Inkling and restoration fault qualification remain unsupported on this AMD host.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: unequal logprobs produced avg_kl_div=5.0000069648240756e-11 and the candidate/default 1e-9 averaged threshold accepted it.
Passing-after regression: exact mode accepts identical values, rejects the review's below-threshold nonzero KL, and rejects a 1e-12 difference whose computed KL rounds to zero; 3 tests passed.
The consolidated file collects 24 tests, including baseline, prefill-cache-hit, and decode-cache-hit unified-memory cases for Python and Rust tree backends. This is discovery evidence only.
Inkling import reaches the NVIDIA CUTE implementation and fails with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'cutlass' on the assigned AMD gfx950/ROCm host.

gpu_execution_evidence: rocm-smi identified one AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950. No supported Inkling inference or unified-memory regression executed on GPU.
remaining_limitations: Neither the Python nor Rust unified-memory class completed an end-to-end Inkling request.
No supported NVIDIA CUTLASS/CUTE path or qualifying Inkling weights were available, so no exact-zero GPU KL/logprob result was measured.
No unified-memory FULL, SWA, or MAMBA restoration defect was demonstrated failing before and passing after through revert-then-red or fault injection.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify Inkling's combined FULL/SWA/MAMBA architecture.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
